indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ad_clicks_pkey ON public.ad_clicks USING btree (id)

indexes.name: ad_clicks_slot_clicked_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX ad_clicks_slot_clicked_idx ON public.ad_clicks USING btree (ad_slot_id, clicked_at DESC)

relations.name: ad_clicks_with_names
relations.view:
SELECT ac.id,
    ac.ad_slot_id,
    ads.name AS ad_name,
    ads.url AS ad_url,
    ads."position" AS ad_position,
    ac.ip,
    ac.user_agent,
    ac.referrer,
    ac.clicked_at
   FROM (public.ad_clicks ac
     LEFT JOIN public.ad_slots ads ON ((ads.id = ac.ad_slot_id)))
  ORDER BY ac.clicked_at DESC;
